dataset.name: BAWSeg (four-year UAV multispectral benchmark, barley paddocks near Kondinin, Western Australia)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 Multispectral (P4M), 2020-2023, 4 campaigns, 2 commercial paddocks (E2/E8) ~0.60 km2 total, nadir, 120 m altitude, 80% overlap -> GSD ~6.35 cm/pixel. 3 classes (barley, ryegrass weed, other). Deployment protocols: within-plot / cross-plot / cross-year.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed-class IoU 0.635 (within-plot) reported, not weed F1.

params_M.ambiguity: VISA param count not isolated in extracted text.
